article.title: Service on several defendants.
article.content: Save as otherwise prescribed, where there are more defendants than one, service of the summons shall be made on each defendant.
article.html:
11Service on several defendants.

Order 5, Rule 11

Save as otherwise prescribed, where there are more defendants than one, service of the summons shall be made on each defendant.
